region.name: Carmel-by-the-Sea
region.definition: Incorporated city limits of Carmel-by-the-Sea, Monterey County, California, United States. Excludes Carmel Valley, Carmel Highlands and other unincorporated Carmel areas.
region.context_notes: Keep city measurements separate from county proxies. Clearly label every county-scale fallback; never describe it as a city measurement. Prefer city-specific Census ACS place data and adopted municipal reports.

tiers.name: Official local government
tiers.description: The jurisdiction itself: city/county departments, adopted plans, open-data portals, utility reports.

tiers.name: State and federal statistical agencies
tiers.description: Census/ACS, CDC, EPA, HUD, BLS, state departments — official series with the jurisdiction as a reporting unit.

tiers.name: Established research institutions
tiers.description: Universities, national labs, and long-running nonprofit research series with published methodology.
examples: Feeding America Map the Meal Gap

tiers.name: Reputable secondary reporting
tiers.description: Journalism and advocacy reports that cite primary data — acceptable only when tiers 1–3 are exhausted, and flagged for review.
